notes.title: Patch note 1.3.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch note 1.3.0[/h1]

Good evening, Shaper players!
I'm here with a brand-new update, 1.3.0, to add even more content.

Let's get the news rolling!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new game mode arrives with this update: adventure mode!
Grab your sword and explore 2 new dungeons that will put you to the test.
Adventure mode is a great way to get your feet wet and discover the game's possibilities.

The adventure mode will evolve by the time in addition to the upcoming dungeons themes.
My goal is to create worlds with several dungeons in each of these worlds. 
Exactly like a certain game with a plumber who moves around with green pipes and eats mushrooms.

[*] The game now got its own speedrun.com page. Play now and submit your runs!
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] The speedrun timer has been completely reworked.
[*] The pushable block now got a smoother push animation (0.2 seconds insteand of 0.1)
[*] Huge rework of the input system to make it more flexible and prepare the game to a future update to make the Steam Input API works.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an animation problem on several entities.
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
The latest update has just arrived, but we can already focus on future updates to come.

On the agenda: a brand-new, fully interactive tutorial, the ability to merge 2 rooms together and the addition of Undo/Redo.
I'd also like to add content to the dungeon editor with new entities, decoration and dungeon themes.

All these features take a lot of time to implement, but I'm doing my utmost to improve the game day by day.

Thanks for reading, and see you soon for another update.

notes.title: Patch note 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch note 1.2.0[/h1]

Hello everyone!
I'm very happy to be back with you after more than a month's work for a new update, with new things to discover and lots of fixes.

Without further ado, let's get to know what's new!

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] The locked block is a new entity which can be opened using a little key. Use it when you want to create a unique path but with a key required to continue on that way!
[*] Broken arrows now stick to the walls when you use the bow, a sign of your lightning-fast attack.
[*] The mouse support has been added to the options menu, so you'll be much faster when you want to change few settings.
[*] I added a little button on the titlescreen to make you join the game's Discord server and give me a lot of feedbacks to improve the game ːlunar2019grinningpigː (you can also click [url=https://discord.gg/ac5zTMEAbw]here[/url] to quickly join it!)
[*] Last but not least, the major feature of this update, the interactive minimap. I'm still working on it, but it's now easier to navigate between all the current floor's rooms because you can simply open the minimap et click on a room to quickly go on it. Let me know if you want this feature to be upgraded!
[/list]

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] There is a new look for the UI! Make sure to check it out and give me your feedback!
[*] Some entities got a new look like the switch blocks and the switch crystals for example.
[*] You can now place a door without a doorway to create teleports even faster.
Similarly, staircases have been removed from the editor menu and will be generated automatically when you place a pair of doors on a different floor.
[*] There is now an error screen if the dungeon upload to the server failed.
[*] A minimum delay has been added to the bow.
[*] The game is now paused when the player's inventory is opened.
[*] When you pick up an object, it will be automatically equiped if there is any place in your hands!
[*] Messages displayed when you open a chest has been changed.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to place walls decorations and then removing walls without removing decorations.
[*] Spikes blocks will now correctly detect collisions with all the walls between itself and the player.
[*] End of a weird behavior when a player was abose a switch block and hit the switch crystal to make the block up. The player is now no longer stuck inside the block and the block will keep down while the player is above it.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to open the main menu while the minimap was opened.
[/list]

Do not hesitate to join the game's Discord server and give me feedback. This is very important for me to improve the game by fixing all the issues and adding features you'd like to see inside Shaper.

I got many more ideas to improve the game. The game is far from the end of it's development.

Thanks all for your support!

notes.title: Patch note: v1.1.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Adding a new button inside the pause menu[/h2]
When you play an online dungeon, you can now use a "Retry" button if you want to quickly retry a dungeon.

[h2]A quick adjustment[/h2]
When you want to push a block, you have to keep your velocity during at least 0.1s before the block is pushed. 
It's also not possible to move a block when you are moving diagonaly to avoid non desired pushing.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed spikes blocks behavior to avoid some issues.
[*] Fixed gameover screen
[*] Fixed player invincibility
[*] Fixed player movement after teleportation
[*] Fixed title screen tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Variant chests now display the contained item.
[*] Octopus and Ghost are now immune to ground peaks.
[*] Resolved a bug that prevented the Ghost from disappearing.
[*] The Ghost now exhibits a new behavior, running towards the player when their back is turned.
[*] Replaced the cursor on the right side of the dungeon name input field.
[*] Animated icons now appear when saving the dungeon or modifying options.
[*] Added a gameover situation.
[*] Updated the key for validating dungeon names, now using ENTER instead of "End."
[*] Octopuses now delay their next bullet if they have hit the player previously.
[*] Fixed the screen displayed upon completing a dungeon.
[*] Corrected the loading issue with torch variants.
[*] Added the ability to remove an object from a chest by right-clicking in object mode.
[*] Introduced a button for renaming existing dungeons.
[*] Implemented a button for removing existing dungeons.
[*] Added descriptions to all entities when the mouse cursor hovers over them.
[*] On the first launch, the game automatically sets up according to the player's client language.
[*] Displayed hotkeys for quickly changing categories using the keyboard.
[*] Introducing a new dungeon theme.
[*] Improved the player character's facing direction when using a gamepad.
[*] Changed the hotkey for switching between edit mode and testing mode to ENTER.
[*] Updated the hotkey for opening the inventory to TAB.
[*] Altered the mouse cursor appearance when hovering over entities within the current room.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player clone would teleport through door entries.
[*] The game now pauses when the Steam overlay is opened.
[*] Updated camera behavior to ensure teleportation transitions take 0.75 seconds.
[*] Various updates to the game engine.
[*] Camera transitions now follow a cubic curve for smoother animation.
[*] Fixed a bug where entities were not displayed in the left panel after the first mode switch using the keyboard.
[*] Enabled the deletion of pickable entities from chests or enemies.
[*] Made updates to the Ghost behavior.
[*] Improved the Bat behavior.
[/list]
